notes.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: Oklahoma City is without Chet Holmgren (out eight to 10 weeks), Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace and Alex Caruso, so the offense runs through him even more. He played only 28 minutes in Wednesday's blowout loss; Houston is on the second night of a back-to-back and has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Victor Wembanyama: He has gone 29 points in 27 minutes and 36 points with 14 rebounds in 39 minutes in his last two games. Tobias Harris is out again, and Minnesota is on a back-to-back without Anthony Edwards; the 12.5-point spread is the only worry for his minutes.
notes.Donovan Mitchell: Jaylon Tyson is out, which keeps Cleveland's wing rotation thin. Mitchell has played 31 to 38 minutes in his last three games and gets the second-highest total on the slate at Milwaukee.
notes.Domantas Sabonis: Keegan Murray, Maxime Raynaud and Dylan Cardwell are all out, so Sacramento has almost no other big men. He has played 35 to 40 minutes in every game and has 14 or 15 rebounds in each of his last three.
notes.Evan Mobley: He made a career-high five threes Wednesday but took a back seat Thursday with 11 points in 33 minutes. With Jaylon Tyson out, he should again play around 33 minutes at Milwaukee.
notes.Cam Spencer: He has moved ahead of Scotty Pippen Jr. in the Memphis rotation and had eight points, six rebounds and eight assists in 23 minutes Thursday. Ty Jerome and Pippen are both questionable, which could push Spencer into a bigger role or a start.
notes.Meleek Thomas: He is questionable tonight after missing Thursday. If he plays, Jaylon Tyson's absence opens wing minutes, and he had been getting about 20 minutes a night off the bench.
notes.Jerami Grant: He has played 22 to 27 minutes off the Memphis bench in every game, but scored only two points in 27 minutes Thursday. Quinten Post is doubtful, which can leave more frontcourt minutes for him.
notes.Jaylin Williams: With Chet Holmgren out for eight to 10 weeks, he has averaged about 23 minutes over Oklahoma City's last two games. He is more of a passing, perimeter big, so his production has been uneven.
notes.Aday Mara: Chet Holmgren is out eight to 10 weeks, and Mara has played 20 and 21 minutes in the two games since. He had 11 points, 10 rebounds and two blocks in 20 minutes Monday.
notes.Kingston Flemings: He closed over CJ McCollum and scored 23 points in 28 minutes Wednesday, then dropped to 16 minutes Thursday. Atlanta-New Orleans has the highest total on the slate at 240.5, and Jordan Poole is out for the Pelicans.
notes.Sam Merrill: He played 27 minutes and made four threes Thursday with Meleek Thomas out. If Thomas sits again, Merrill's minutes should stay in the high 20s with Jaylon Tyson also out.
notes.Keldon Johnson: Tobias Harris is out with a calf strain, and Johnson has played 22 to 26 minutes off the bench in every game. He has scored between 19 and 21 DraftKings points in each of his last three.
notes.Clint Capela: He started at center Friday with Alperen Sengun out and had 11 rebounds and five assists in 30 minutes. Houston has not posted its injury report for tonight, so Sengun's status is not posted yet.
notes.LaMelo Ball: He scored a season-high 24 points in 29 minutes Friday in Minnesota's first win without Anthony Edwards, who is out up to two months after knee surgery. Minnesota is on a back-to-back and has not posted its injury report yet.
notes.Jaylen Brown: He missed Friday with left knee soreness, and the team did not say whether he would miss more games. Philadelphia has not posted its injury report for tonight's back-to-back at Charlotte, so his status is not posted.
